text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy and I have headed out<n>for some fun
today, but she seems<n>preoccupied...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking... I've gotten pretty<n>good as an
evil boss...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But I'm still not a real tyrant who<n>rules her lackeys
with an iron—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What the heck is that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look over and see a festival float by<n>the roadside. I
guess there must be a<n>festival happening soon.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Th-that's it! That's just what I need!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If I steal something that huge and<n>flashy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Then I'll definitely become a big bad!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Okay, lackey! Hurry up and go steal<n>that festival
float!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can actually steal it,<n>but I wonder
if the workers will let me<n>carry it for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that'd be great! We were in a bit<n>of a bind
because we didn't have<n>enough people to carry it!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, c'mon! The festival's about to<n>start! Grab on
to that pole there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hurrah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Why is my lackey carrying it withthem?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
My orders were to steal it! Graaagh,<n>why do I
always have to do<n>everything myself?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wait! But maybe...

text_block_list.name: Sleepless Demon Buono
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! You merely defeated<n>my lackeys!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(That's it! It's just like what<n>happened in that
show! First the<n>lackeys get defeated, and then...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The evil boss makes her awesome<n>entrance!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! We've reached the main<n>street! Let's
hear them shouts loud<n>and clear!
Hold it right theeere!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wicked Windy has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It seems you've captured my lackey,<n>but I won't
be defeated so easily!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After announcing her arrival, Shinko<n>Windy leaps up
on top of the festival<n>float!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There! I've seized your float! Now,<n>full speed
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, seems we've got a<n>last-minute passenger!
Nice! This<n>year's festival is gonna get even<n>more
wild!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: I love the parade float this year! It's<n>extra lively!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mwahahaha! Did you see me?! I was<n>rampaging
through town!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I stole the float, and bent 'em all to<n>my will using
the power of fear!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I got up to some real evil boss<n>exploits!
choice_data_list: You were definitely the star of the show.
You were definitely the star of the show.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course I was! Everyone was<n>lookin' right at me
and thinkin' how<n>awesome I was!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You did good too, makin' yourself<n>look all puny and
strugglin' to carry<n>the float—just like a proper
lackey!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Your pathetic showing made me<n>stand out even
more!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Keep up the effort for my sake!
choice_data_list: Wouldn't it feel better to do nice things?
I'll strive to be the best lackey I can be!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yup! I never get sick of hearing that<n>response!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Every evil organization needs lackeys<n>with great
voices!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Okay! On the way home, we're gonna<n>train those
vocal chords! Repeat after<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mwaaahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us return home, cackling in<n>the way any
respectable member of<n>an evil organization should.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What the heck are ya saying? I just<n>proved how
great it feels to do bad<n>stuff!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep chargin' down the<n>path of evil and
evil alone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So make sure ya don't fall behind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy believes she did<n>something
particularly dastardly. For<n>better or worse, I vow to
continue<n>supporting her while she thrives as<n>the
center of attention.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Have ya awakened to your<n>calling as my
lackey?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This must be the fruits of my efforts<n>in training you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now, give your incredible boss heaps<n>of praise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I vow to continue supporting<n>my boss as
her loyal lackey.
